StatDef.label: flight (sec.)
StatDef.description: Seconds of continuous flight on full stamina at the normal drain rate: 10 seconds at 100% flight. Bionic wings use stamina 2–4 ​​times slower and archotech wings 5–10 times slower, so with them winged pawns stays in the air correspondingly longer.

PawnCapacityDef.label: flight
PawnCapacityDef.description: The ability to fly. It depends on the condition of both wings and on consciousness. Artificial wings work at a fixed level. Without a wing, flight is impossible.
